Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.SettingsProfileTooltip: Save the current Cheats, Hotkeys and Weapon Mod boost values to a file, or load a previously saved file. Favorites are not included and keep working as they always have.
Settings.DestroyTargetTooltip: Deletes the object you are currently looking at. This can remove world objects, invisible barriers, or important level parts. Use carefully.
Settings.DestroyLastSpawnedTooltip: Destroys the actor(s) created by your most recent Spawn/Force action.
Settings.DestroyNearbySpawnedTooltip: Destroys any previously spawned items within a small radius around you.
Settings.FastPlayerActionsTooltip: Speeds up skill, attack, and evade animations. Re-press after changing areas.
Settings.BoostWeaponModsTooltip:
Boosts damage, duration, and charges on your currently equipped weapon mods. Safe to use repeatedly.

Each field is a multiplier on the mod's base value — e.g. 10 means 10x. Exception: "...Frequency" and "...Delay" fields are time intervals, so a higher number makes them trigger less often. Use a value below 1 for those if you want more frequent triggers.
Settings.InfiniteHealthTooltip: God Mode: zeroes all incoming damage before it is applied.
Settings.NoFallDamageTooltip: Works most of the time but hasn't been fully tested yet — you may occasionally still take fall damage.
Settings.SetAllWeaponLevelTooltip: Sets every equipped weapon to this level. 232 is the highest level currently known to have any effect in-game — higher values are not expected to go further.
Main.SummonTraitTooltip: Uses SummonTrait. Spawn one trait, pick it up, then spawn the next one.
Main.AddTraitTooltip: Uses AddTrait. Adds the trait directly through the Summonable Traits mod.
Main.UpdateTooltip: Click to download and install the update
Main.MissingOnlyTooltip: Show only weapons, armor, accessories, mutators and relics that aren't in your inventory yet. Needs an inventory scan from the game.
Main.ScanInventoryTooltip: Read your in-game inventory now. While a character is loaded it is also rescanned automatically every few seconds.
Main.SpawnMissingTooltip: Spawn one of every item that isn't in your inventory yet: from the selected subcategory, or from all tracked items under All.
Main.CollectionNoScan: No inventory scan yet. Load a character in-game with the mod running.
Main.CollectionUntracked: {0} is not tracked. Only weapons, armor, accessories, mutators and relics are.
Main.ContentFilterTooltip: Show items from the base game or from one DLC. The collection counts and Spawn Missing follow this filter too.
Main.LastScanStale: Last scan {0} (not live: game closed or not in-game)
